mechanism_narrative: The within-window improvement in RETAIL_REC from -89.3 at t-2w to -88.0 at t-0w marks a bottoming of the retail-and-recreation collapse; this momentum continues over the next four weeks, raising the next 28-day mean relative to the last 28-day mean.
failure_condition: The mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to its mean over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Transit use is a prerequisite for broad retail-and-recreation footfall. If the TRANSIT weekly mean crosses above -80.0, it signals restored willingness to move through public space, and RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: TRANSIT rises above -80.0 but the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is not higher than the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Commuting and transit capacity jointly enable discretionary retail trips. When WORKPLACES rises above -70 and TRANSIT rises above -80 within the same week, the combined mobility recovery lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES > -70 AND TRANSIT > -80 in same week
failure_condition: Both WORKPLACES > -70 and TRANSIT > -80 occur, yet the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is not higher than the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restrictions regime, elevated RESIDENTIAL mobility reflects stay-at-home mandates that directly suppress retail-and-recreation trips. As long as RESIDENTIAL stays above +32, RETAIL_REC remains below its recent mean over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL remains above +32 but the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is higher than its last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Essential errands and outdoor activity act as a combined leading indicator of broader mobility. When GROCERY_PHARM stays above -55 and PARKS rises above -75, the interaction signals enough normal activity to lift RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM > -55 and PARKS > -75 both occur, but RETAIL_REC's next 28-day mean is not higher than its last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Spring weather raises outdoor mobility even under restrictions. A PARKS weekly mean crossing above -75 reflects seasonal warming, and this outdoor activity spills over into retail-and-recreation trips over the following four weeks.
failure_condition: PARKS rises above -75.0 but the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is not higher than its last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Households are substituting discretionary retail trips with essential grocery-and-pharmacy trips. As long as GROCERY_PHARM remains above -55 while RETAIL_REC is near -88, discretionary spending stays suppressed and RETAIL_REC falls over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM remains above -55 but the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is higher than its last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Remote-work persistence plus stay-at-home behavior jointly suppress retail demand. When RESIDENTIAL exceeds +33 and WORKPLACES stays below -72 in the same week, the interaction predicts lower RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL > +33 and WORKPLACES < -72 co-occur, but RETAIL_REC's next 28-day mean is not lower than its last 28-day mean.
